newsitem.title: UK: NWE/Med VGO prices static, US arb window shut firm - May 14.
newsitem.headline: NWE/Med VGO prices static, US arb window shut firm - May 14.

text.p: European VGO prices were largely static mid-week, with the drop in U.S. gasoline values firmly closing the arbitrage window to North America.
A cargo of low sulphur VGO sold from a French refinery earlier in the week to a trader for transatlantic shipment, at a time when the profit could still be locked in on the paper market.
Another cargo from the same refinery was being offered for early June, while an Italian shipment was on offer for later this month.
High sulphur VGO was arousing little interest. --London newsroom +44 171 542 8060
